# Menu 250 in camera mode: the copied accessory keys onto the selected
# accessory, at the current frame.
load accessory .\tri.x
load accessory .\tri2.x
select camera
select accessory tri.x
frame 10
accessory position 1 2 3
register accessory
frame 20
accessory position 4 5 6
register accessory
select all accessory
copy
select accessory tri2.x
frame 40
paste different
save pmm pasted.pmm
